purpose: First JCS-discriminating cross-language vector for CONF-003 using UTF-16 member ordering.

execution_contract.cross_language_requirement: RI-PY and RI-RS MUST emit identical canonical bytes, SHA-256 digest, and RFC-6962 leaf hash
execution_contract.discriminating_requirement: Observed RFC8785-JCS output MUST differ from naive sorted JSON output that sorts by Unicode code point

profile_discrimination.expected_difference_note: RFC 8785 JCS must order keys as z, é, 😀, ﬀ. A naive Unicode code-point sort orders z, é, ﬀ, 😀.
